title: Your $6 coffee costs $147,359
caption: $6 a workday = $1,560 a year. Invested at 7% for 30 years = $147,359. What's your daily habit? I'll run your numbers next. (Illustration assuming a 7% average yearly return. Not financial advice.) #money #personalfinance #fintok #investing

title: $1,000,000 now or a penny that doubles for 30 days?
caption: A penny doubled every day for 30 days = $5,368,709. On day 20 it's only $5,243. That's compounding. Which one did you pick? #money #personalfinance #fintok #compoundinterest

title: The money cheat code nobody taught you (Rule of 72)
caption: Rule of 72: divide 72 by your interest rate to see how many years it takes your money to double. At 7% that's about 10 years; at 1% it's 72 years. Save this and show your parents. #money #personalfinance #fintok #moneytips

title: Your birthday money could be worth $24,528
caption: Invest $200 of birthday money every year from 13 to 18 ($1,200 total) and never touch it. At 7% a year it's about $24,528 by 60. Show your parents. (Illustration, 7% average yearly return assumed. Not financial advice.) #money #personalfinance #fintok #investing

title: Becoming a millionaire costs less than $10 a day
caption: Invest $9.59 a day from age 15 and at 7% a year you hit $1,000,000 by 60. Start at 35 and you'd need way more. Time is the cheat code. (Illustration, not financial advice.) #money #personalfinance #fintok #millionaire

title: Those $10 game skins could cost you $20,266
caption: $10 a month on skins from 13 to 23 = $1,200. Invested at 7% instead, that's about $20,266 by 60. Not saying stop gaming, just know the real price. (Illustration, not financial advice.) #money #personalfinance #gaming #fintok
